name: Droost Display
description: SDC-first display orchestration for AI agents: introspect UI Patterns sources, read entity view displays as an abstract component mapping, and compose displays from SDCs deterministically — exposed as MCP tools.
project_description: Droost Display exposes SDC-first (Single Directory Component) entity-display orchestration to AI coding agents as MCP tools, built on UI Patterns and ui_patterns_field_formatters. droost_display_sources lists what can feed an SDC prop or slot (the UI Patterns source registry, filtered exactly as the Manage Display UI filters — including a field's dynamic field_property:* / field_formatter:* derivatives). droost_display_get reads an entity view display as an abstract field -> component prop/slot mapping, unwrapping UI Patterns component-formatter bindings. droost_display_compose is the write side: it takes that abstract mapping, validates every field, component, prop/slot name, required prop and source applicability against the component schema and the source registry, then persists the EntityViewDisplay through the entity API so dependencies are calculated for real; dry_run validates without saving. The write tool is gated (requires droost.settings.allow_config_write and the CLI transport). A hook_requirements install check warns when Drupal Canvas is also present because both take over the SDC plugin manager. Local development only.
